 Advertisement Bernalillo County offers discounted Uber rides for Halloween weekend
 Bernalillo County "take a ride on us" offering free rides SOURCE: Bernalillo County Advertisement Updated: 4:48 PM MDT Oct 29, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Amari Saxton Digital Assignment Editor Bernalillo County offers discounted Uber rides for Halloween weekend
 Updated: 4:48 PM MDT Oct 29, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Amari Saxton Digital Assignment Editor ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. — With Halloween approaching, Bernalillo County officials are offering free and safe rides for the public.
 With their "Take a Ride On Us" program, residents can enjoy the holiday responsibly, while knowing they have a safe ride home. 
 Advertisement To receive the offer, riders can open the Uber app, go to “vouchers,” and enter the code HALLOW26 to receive up to $10 off two trips. The offer is valid for up to 2,500 rides on a first-come, first-served basis. The discount is limited to Uber rides and does not apply to Uber Eats orders or cover driver tips.
 The offer begins Friday, October 30 at 10 a.m. and lasts through 2 a.m. on Sunday, Nov. 1.
